literal_meaning: গঙ্গায় পা দেওয়া (dipping foot in the Ganga river)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অসুখ এতটাই গুরুতর হয়েছে যে গঙ্গায় পা দিয়েছে।
বুড়ো মানুষটি গঙ্গায় পা দিয়ে শেষ নিশ্বাস নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: His illness has become so severe that he has one foot in the grave.
The old man took his last breath with one foot in the grave.
history: This idiom draws from Hindu traditions where bathing in the Ganga is believed to cleanse sins and prepare the soul for death, often performed by the terminally ill.
note: The input text 'গঙ্গাদিকে পা' appears to be a variant or typographical error; standardized to the common form 'গঙ্গায় পা' based on cultural context.
